experience.description: Managed and optimized company profiles on Upwork, Fiverr, LinkedIn, Dribbble, and Behance to attract high-quality leads. Coordinated with cross-functional teams to align project scope, timelines, and deliverables.

Remote | Managed and maintained Upwork profiles to maximize visibility and conversion rates. Executed targeted outreach campaigns using Close CRM and Apollo to nurture prospective clients. Managed and tracked leads throughout the sales pipeline using Close CRM and Apollo, improving follow-up efficiency. Contributed to agency revenue growth by identifying and pursuing new business opportunities.
